formulas.absolute_score: sum over criteria of (score / max_score) * weight
formulas.benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across all suppliers in the run
formulas.gap: score - benchmark (0 for the benchmark leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.relative_pct: score / benchmark * 100; if benchmark == 0 then 0 (no supplier showed evidence, no peer credit)

criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.justification: Delta Analytics offers a solid Azure-hosted analytics architecture with packaged dashboards and a certified SAP S/4HANA connector tested up to 10 million spend lines. However, integration for Coupa relies on batch nightly CSV imports rather than a direct API integration.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Hosted analytics platform on Azure with a certified SAP S/4HANA connector and nightly CSV import for Coupa. Tested with 10 million spend lines. Standard spend, supplier and contract dashboards.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.justification: The proposal provides a structured 16-week timeline across clear phases and a dedicated 5 FTE project team. However, the plan relies on a traditional waterfall approach with limited operational detail on contingency planning.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Delivery follows a waterfall plan with a weekly status report and a monthly steering meeting....Team: Project manager, solution architect, 2 data engineers, BI developer (5 FTE)....Monthly risk review; top risks tracked in a shared register.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.justification: The pricing provides a clear fixed-fee breakdown totaling $730,000 across licensing, implementation, connectors, and support over three years. However, total cost is exposed to variable hosting fees estimated at $3,000 per month and places Coupa export operational overhead on Northwind.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] Total $730,000 Assumptions: • Azure consumption billed at cost, estimated at $3,000/month. • Coupa data provided as nightly CSV exports by Northwind.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.justification: The vendor meets key baseline security and governance requirements with ISO/IEC 27001 certification, encryption, SAML SSO, and GDPR compliance. Audit logging is supported for one year, although detailed threat monitoring or penetration test results are not detailed.
criteria.evidence: [Page 1] • ISO/IEC 27001 certified. Encryption at rest and in transit. SSO via SAML 2.0. • Role-based access; audit log retained for 1 year. GDPR DPA available.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.justification: Delta Analytics demonstrates relevant domain experience with four mid-sized retail implementations and defined business-hours support SLAs. A gap is the absence of 24/7 support for critical issues and the deferral of reference access until after shortlisting.
criteria.evidence: [Page 2] Support: Business-hours support with 4-hour response for critical incidents; quarterly service reviews. Relevant experience: Four procurement analytics projects for mid-sized retailers since 2021. References: • Two retail references available after shortlisting.

suppliers.tie_break_note: Ranked above Echo Analytics: PPI tie, earlier submission date (2026-02-20 vs 2026-02-24).
risks: Coupa integration dependency on Northwind to generate nightly CSV exports rather than automated direct connector
Variable Azure consumption costs billed at cost (estimated at $3,000/month) adding approximately $108,000 in unbudgeted risk over three years
Support coverage is restricted to business hours with up to a 4-hour critical response window, offering no after-hours incident coverage
Client references are withheld until shortlisting, preventing immediate verification of past performance
suppliers.overall_summary: Delta Analytics presents a viable, packaged procurement analytics solution hosted on Azure with standard retail dashboards, ISO 27001 compliance, and transparent core pricing of $730,000. However, the proposal carries integration dependencies via CSV for Coupa, variable cloud hosting fees, business-hours-only support, and deferred customer references.
